message: Remote server-side license enforcement. AI Training now checks an active Supabase Edge Function every 2 seconds using the protected core's bound License ID and Hardware ID. The remote authority cryptographically verifies the signed publisher revocation bundle and returns HTTP 403 for revoked/deleted License IDs or blocked hardware. A 403 immediately terminates the running protected game session and persists the revoke lock. Repeated server/network failure closes the game because offline play is disabled. This replaces the fragile v10.0.14 localhost reverse-proxy gate with a real remote decision point while preserving hardware-bound revoke/restore/delete and duplicate-license protection.
